title: Network Command Basics
description: Learn essential network commands and tools for command-line operations

steps.title: Essential Network Commands
steps.content:
Common network commands you'll use frequently:

- ping: Test connectivity
- curl: Transfer data and make HTTP requests
- wget: Download files
- ssh: Secure shell access
- scp: Secure file copy
- netstat/ss: Network statistics

These tools are crucial for remote operations and troubleshooting.

steps.title: Testing Connectivity
steps.content:
The ping command is your first tool for network diagnostics:

- Basic usage: ping example.com
- Limited pings: ping -c 4 example.com
- Check response time: Look at 'time=' values

Common ping patterns:
- Continuous ping: ping host
- Quick test: ping -c 1 host
- With timestamp: ping -D host

practical_task.description: Test connectivity to google.com with exactly 3 pings. What command did you use?

steps.title: Working with HTTP
steps.content:
curl is a powerful tool for HTTP operations:

- GET request: curl url
- Download file: curl -O url
- Show headers: curl -I url
- POST request: curl -X POST url
- With data: curl -d "data" url

Common flags:
- -v: Verbose output
- -L: Follow redirects
- -H: Add headers

practical_task.description: Make a GET request to https://api.github.com/zen. What command did you use?

steps.title: Downloading Files
steps.content:
wget specializes in file downloads:

- Basic download: wget url
- Save as: wget -O filename url
- Continue partial: wget -c url
- Recursive: wget -r url
- With auth: wget --user=x --password=y url

Best practices:
- Always use -c for large files
- Check integrity after download
- Use -P to specify directory

exercises.question: What command tests basic connectivity to a host?
exercises.explanation: ping sends ICMP echo requests to test if a host is reachable and measure response time.

exercises.question: What flag limits ping to a specific number of attempts?
exercises.explanation: ping -c NUMBER sends exactly NUMBER pings and then stops.

exercises.question: What command is best for making HTTP requests?
exercises.explanation: curl is a versatile tool for transferring data with URLs and making HTTP requests.

exercises.question: What wget flag continues a partial download?
exercises.explanation: wget -c resumes a partial download instead of starting over.
